ci_fix.focused_test: cargo test -p server-browser protocol: 17 passed, 21 filtered out.

rust_1_99_check.result: The production loop lint was resolved, then the new assert_is_empty lint reported 180 existing test assertions across the workspace. Rust 1.99 migration is left for an explicit toolchain upgrade.

ci_fix.validated_toolchain: Rust 1.98.1 full workspace strict Clippy, build, tests and coverage; Rust 1.99.0 fmt also passed.

remaining_gaps: Real Harness profile/authentication, model inference and native tool execution have not been exercised; offline ACP peer and real Rust server process tests are used.
Windows and Linux runtime behavior were not measured on this macOS host; CI should run the Linux suite, and Windows process cleanup needs a native-host check.

Uncovered adapter branches include unsupported resume/close capabilities, provider prompt error/unknown stopReason, unknown callback rejection, queue limits and stdin write failures/timeouts. Add malformed-peer and backpressure scenarios before widening the ACP capability surface.
